'''Bheriz''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] celestial body located in the [[Bheriz sector/Legends|Bheriz sector]]. The local [[Bherizian]]s produced processed granules of the commercially important [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] [[teniline]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[viceroy of Bheriz]] negotiated a deal with the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] in which Bheriz would exchange half its [[Local year|annual]] teniline output for access to [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-controlled [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]].

==Description==
Bheriz was a celestial body<ref name="TCWnovel" /> located in the [[Bheriz system/Legends|Bheriz system]], a part of the [[Bheriz sector/Legends|Bheriz sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], which linked it to the [[Aduba system/Legends|Aduba system]] as well as the [[Formos system/Legends|Formos system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]].<ref name="EAOC Outer Rim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Bheriz possessed deposits of the [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] [[teniline]].<ref name="TCWnovel" />

==History==
[[File:Jabba_TCWPB.png|thumb|right|300px|Bheriz negotiated a trade deal with Jabba Desilijic Tiure (pictured).]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Bheriz was a part of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]<ref name="TEA" /> and produced processed teniline granules, which were critical to the manufacture of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]].<ref name="TCWnovel" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the [[viceroy of Bheriz]] traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TCWnovel" /> of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> There, he intended to negotiate a deal with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] in which Bheriz would trade a quarter of its total [[Local year|annual]] output of teniline in exchange for free passage along Hutt-controlled [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]]. During their meeting, however, Jabba&mdash;who believed it was cheaper and easier to negotiate a deal rather than take the teniline granules by force but was still willing to do the latter if the need arose&mdash;increased Bheriz's part of the agreement to half its annual output instead.<ref name="TCWnovel" />

==Inhabitants==
The inhabitants of Bheriz were known as the [[Bherizian]]s. The [[Viceroy/Legends|viceroy]] of Bheriz was a representative of the celestial body.<ref name="TCWnovel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bheriz was first mentioned in [[Karen Traviss]]'<ref name="TCWnovel" /> [[July 26]], [[2008]]<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of<ref name="TCWnovel" /> the [[August 15]], 2008 [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|film]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (multimedia project)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' multimedia project]].<ref name="YearByYear" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Bheriz [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Bheriz itself, in grid square U-10.<ref name="TEA" />
